knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A fibrous backing is a stop-and-refer trigger. Leave it undisturbed, record it and refer it. Removal is licensed work.
Supplier documentation and a record of what was fitted are the basis for any later statement about the foam.
This lesson grants no licence. Asbestos removal is licensed work under the rules of the state or territory.
The frame, springs and webbing section says to inspect the frame joints and check the springs and webbing for breaks and sag before covering.

practicalCriteria: Screening completed before old materials are cut or stripped back
Frame and webbing inspected and repaired before covering
Supplier documents on file for foam and filling
Pattern aligned, tension even and seams checked
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% or higher. With three checks this means all three must be correct. Practical sign-off is separate: every practical criterion must be observed and met by the assessor. A knowledge pass is not practical competence and does not count toward sign-off.
evidenceRequired: Supplier documentation for foam and filling
stopWorkCriteria: Fibrous, board-like or unknown backing disturbed
